name: IOI: John and Mary
description: Classic indirect-object-identification style example. The clean prompt ends with the model likely predicting ' Mary' (the recipient); the corrupted prompt swaps the second subject so the model likely repeats ' John'. The patch copies a clean-run activation at the second-subject position into the corrupted run.

source.citation: Wang et al. 2022, Interpretability in the Wild

expected_behavior: The clean prompt should make ' Mary' more likely than ' John'. Presets are starting points; outcomes are measured, never assumed.

pairs.clean_text: John and Mary went to the shop. John gave a book to
pairs.corrupted_text: John and Mary went to the shop. Mary gave a book to

recommended_hooks.note: residual stream after block 5 at the second subject; verified strong effect (recovery ~0.9)
residual stream after block 6 at the second subject
residual stream after block 9 at the final position
per-head z-values at the second subject
